name: zvideo_dd_clear_screen_and_zbuffer_rect
description: zVideo_dd::ClearScreenAndZBufferRect conditionally clears a color DirectDraw surface rectangle, then clears the current Z-buffer rectangle with provider Restore retry handling.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob1_md_facs produced symbol ?ClearScreenAndZBufferRect@zVideo_dd@@YIHPAUzVidRect32@@PAUzVideo_SurfaceStatePartial@@@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x4a8220 after COFF relocation masking (36 relocation bytes, 0 trim nops; BN size 208, VC size 208).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a8220 validates fastcall ECX=dstRect and EDX=colorSurfaceState, DDBLTFX dwSize 0x64 initialization, guarded color fill when g_zVideo_ClearScreenBufferEnabled is nonzero, color fill value from g_zVideo_ClearColorPacked16, provider IDirectDrawSurface3::Blt through vtable offset 0x14 with colorSurfaceState->surf, destination rect ECX, null source arguments, flags DDBLT_COLORFILL | DDBLT_WAIT, DDERR_SURFACELOST handling through provider Restore at vtable offset 0x6c, ReportError with zvid_dd.c line 0x267 on permanent color clear failure, early return after color failure, optional g_zVideo_pZBufferSurface guard, Z fill value 0, provider Blt with flags DDBLT_DEPTHFILL, Restore retry, and ReportError line 0x27f on permanent Z clear failure.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a8220 has no warnings and matches the existing source implementation. The only non-provider authored callee is zVideo_dd::ReportError, which is tier C or better.
The dependency frontier shows no remaining authored source blockers; Blt and Restore are DirectDraw provider calls for color and Z-buffer surfaces.

The native smoke installs fake DirectDrawSurface3 provider surfaces and verifies enabled color clear followed by Z clear, disabled color clear still performing Z clear, DDERR_SURFACELOST plus successful Restore retry on the color surface before the Z pass, color clear failure suppressing the Z pass, null source arguments, destination rectangle forwarding, fill flags, fill color, dwSize, and zero depth fill value.
